scripts.build: tsc -b packages/wire-contracts packages/canonical packages/temporal packages/schema packages/core packages/exchange apps/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/wire-contracts packages/canonical packages/temporal packages/schema packages/core packages/exchange apps/cli --pretty false
scripts.verify:contracts: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/main.js contract-kit verify wmm-v0.3-contract-kit
scripts.verify:v0: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/main.js v0 verify wmm-v0.3-contract-kit fixtures/v0/semantic-contract-cases.json
scripts.verify:seed: pnpm build && node apps/cli/dist/main.js seed validate wmm-v0.3-contract-kit
scripts.check: pnpm verify:kit && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
